segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: some say it controls shine and gives a natural glow with no white cast, while several others describe it as too greasy, heavy, or discoball-shiny and recommend oily types avoid it.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers most consistently praise this product as a holy grail, describing it as deeply hydrating, dewy without being greasy, and well suited to their skin, though a couple found it too heavy or slow to sink in on dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report a nice glow without excess oil, though one notes it's overkill on top of hydrating toners and better suited to drier skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: many report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts and call it a holy grail, but others describe rashes, burning, itching, or stinging especially near the eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or aging skin report a restored glow, good hydration, and comfortable all-day wear under makeup.
segments.normal: A reviewer with normal/combination skin and an oily T-zone reports it looks beautiful under makeup but heavy and greasy when worn alone.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with mature or aging skin (40s-60s) report the product restores glow to dull, dry, menopausal skin and wears well under makeup for a youthful look; no negative reports specific to aging skin.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report strong, lasting hydration and a dewy finish they consider a holy grail; one dry-skin reviewer nonetheless found it too greasy over the course of the day.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report the product caused bright red, itchy, or burning skin reactions, including one who does not normally consider herself sensitive; this is a minority report against many describing no irritation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the product caused severe migraines she attributes to the ingredients, and another reports stinging around the eyes; most other reviewers report no systemic or barrier-related issues.
concerns.spots: Acne-prone reviewers are split: several state it does not break them out and even improves acne scars via niacinamide, while multiple others report new deep cystic pimples or small rough bumps that cleared after stopping use.
concerns.blemishes: Some acne-prone reviewers highlight reduced redness and less noticeable acne scars with continued use, while others report the opposite, developing new breakouts on the cheeks.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers who describe having oily skin, or who don't but still saw shine, frequently report the product looks greasy or gives a shiny, oily sheen over the day, requiring setting powder; a smaller group with oily skin says it gave glow without added oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Greasy or oily sheen over time
No white cast on deeper skin tones
Pilling under makeup or other products

extraits.texte: Broke me out so bad! I used this a few times, and I got big, deep zits all over my cheeks. Once I stopped using my skin went back to normal.

I bought this due to the ratings, and it's chemical formula - I've never liked the feel of mineral sunscreen (at least the affordable ones) so high hopes! It does feel wonderful on my skin, and doesn't take too long to soak in, but I can't say I'm a fan of the "dew glow" effect. It's acceptable when I first put it on; however, my normally dry, sensitive skin just looks greasy over the course of the day, which doesn't normally happen. And you can imagine this makes reapplying unpleasant. Still a nice product that seems to work for many, and the formula feels nice.

I have been using this product for about a year and a half and it is the only product that has finally restored that youthful illumination/glow to my dull, dry, menopausal skin! I love the fact that it has SPF 50. Will always have this with me for home and travel every day use.

I've been using this since it first came out, and have repurchased it more times than I can count. I have dry, sensitive, acne prone skin and this is a holy grail for me. I do think this may be better for normal to dry skin, as it may be too much for oily skin types. On my skin it's glowy, hydrating and wears well under makeup. LOVE this sunscreen and moisturizer!!!

As an Ulta employee & a ginger skinned woman who has tried every sunblock, this is the best out there. If i had to pick a single product to recommend it would be this. It makes my skin look incredible. It does not break me out (im acne prone and sensitive). It sits beautifully under makeup. When I do not wear makeup it gives me the most natural glow. I get compliments all the time. This product makes me enjoy wearing sunscreen. I cannot recommend this enough. It gives glass skin! I got it because my skincare obsessed 60 year old mom loves it. So its great on mature skin as well. I could bathe in this stuff. 1000/10

I have to recognize the fact that this product does hydrates my skin very well. I wanted to love it 😔 but I find out that the ingredients were causing me severe migraines. Unfortunately, I had to stop using it😔

I've been trying to find a good cruelty free morning spf moisturizer without any mica in it, and i received a deluxe sample of this. I liked it so much I ordered a full size and will likely keep it as my AM moisturizer of choice! It has good skincare benefits in addition to the spf, and i find it goes on nicely and absorbs well without any white cast or pilling. Its also very hydrating. Its true that you need to use a lot to get the full spf benefits, but this is true for any spf. It is a heavier moisturizer, and i do find that if i dont follow it with a healthy amount of setting powder, ill look greasy. I imagine if you have dry skin, though, this would look very nice and dewy. For me, the setting powder does the trick, and the moisturizer wears nicely under my powder foundation too. Ive also has no irritation or breakouts from it. Overall, its a win for me!
